verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence of catalog CSV import/export, bulk product editing, or bulk catalog API operations. The Admin API and GraphiQL items are generic developer building blocks for building apps and running queries; they never mention products, catalogs, or bulk changes. The community mention of 'CSV parsing' is about limited data access, not catalog import/export, so it does not support this story.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can bulk import, export, and edit the catalog — CSV or API — without touching products one at a time
